name: Required tool must actually be used, not guessed around
prompt: The correct timeout value for this service is documented, not memorized. Use the search_docs tool to look it up, then write the value you found to output/value.txt with no trailing content other than the number and a newline. (The documented value is 42.)

metadata.author: VASB maintainers
metadata.rationale: The bad path happens to write the right value from a lucky guess, without ever calling search_docs. Correctness alone would pass it; the tools validator is what catches that the required grounding step never happened.
